name: Notifications
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built to back the kernel's AppNotificationsBell, which shipped with no API 2026-08-24)
description: Per-user database notifications: a paginated feed, unread count, mark-read / mark-all-read, and dismissal, plus the Vue half — the notification bell, a polling composable, and a full notifications page. Ships an ExampleNotification to copy.
